leads.name: Eiche am Wendehammer der Kilianstraße
leads.note: Plain designated street oak at a cul-de-sac in Dörfleins, part of Hallstadt (a separate town in Landkreis Bamberg, not the city of Bamberg), about 4.5 km from the centre. Confirmed as a genuine, currently-photographed tree (Commons category 'Eiche am Wendehammer der Kilianstraße (Hallstadt)' has dated images), and it is on a public street, so access is not the problem. What is missing is any evidence it clears the 'genuinely old OR visually spectacular OR historically significant' bar beyond its legal designation: no age, no girth, no story found in the time available. Also outside the four-candidate research budget for this pass. Worth a second look if Hallstadt/Dörfleins is ever researched on its own, or if a future pass finds an age/girth for it.
leads.species_basis: genus read from the tree's own name; ask the reader which species
leads.position_basis: recovered from the lead's own `coords` field (field)

leads.name: Birnbaum südlich des Rothofer Weges (Naturdenkmal 2)
leads.note: A pear tree (Pyrus communis) about 75 m south of the Rothofer Weg footpath, in the northern part of a field (Acker) near Gaustadt. Likely visible from the path but standing on private farmland, not a place a visitor is invited to walk up to. Not researched further this pass (over the four-candidate budget); a future pass could check whether the field edge is close enough to the path for an honest 'visible from the footpath' entry.

leads.name: Eiche südwestlich des Kaiser-Heinrich-Gymnasiums (Naturdenkmal 5)
leads.note: Pedunculate oak (Quercus robur) per the city ordinance as reproduced on de.wikipedia 'Liste der Naturdenkmäler in Bamberg'. Missing for a RICH page: no girth, height or age in any source (ordinance lists none), no evidence the spot is open ground rather than school grounds, no photo checked. Not delivered in the 2026-10-12 deepen pass.

leads.name: Sommerlinde bei Ebing
leads.note: Summer linden (Tilia platyphyllos) per the register name, 800 m south-west of Ebing at a chapel, 50.00354, 10.89562, about 12 km from Bamberg. Commons category with photographs exists (Sommerlinde ND-03514 bei Ebing). Not verified this pass: photo date, licence, geotag and alive not checked; no girth or age. Candidate for a later photo/pin check.

leads.name: Schafhoflinde bei Leidingshof
leads.note: Named linden west of the entrance to Leidingshof, 49.84132, 11.20996, about 20 km east of Bamberg. Commons category 'Schafhoflinde (Leidingshof)' exists. Same Commons file is captioned as the Teuchatz linden in the Wikipedia list, so identity needs checking against published bam_005 (Great Lime of Teuchatz, 49.87235, 11.10251) before use. Not verified this pass.

leads.name: Zwei Linden in Mürsbach
leads.note: Two lindens at a Marienbildstock in the village centre of Mürsbach (Rattelsdorf), 50.06124, 10.86221, about 20 km north of Bamberg; also a separate '1 Linde' at the church steps at 50.06192, 10.86187. Commons panorama exists. Not verified this pass: dates, licence, alive not checked; no girth or age.

blocked.name: Eiche im Hof des Aufseßhöflein
blocked.reason: Stands in the courtyard ('im Hof') of the Aufseßhöflein, a baroque garden pavilion built 1723-1728 for the Aufseß family. It is privately owned and now operated as a cultural event venue / holiday rental ('Urlaub im Denkmal'), not a place with standing public access; the one piece of evidence found of anyone but the owner being there was a foundation board meeting held on site. This is exactly the 'courtyard of a dwelling' pattern the project treats as private land absent evidence otherwise. Blocked for now; would need a source stating the courtyard is open to casual visitors.

blocked.name: Eiche am Teufelsgraben, im nördlichen Bereich eines Gartengrundstücks
blocked.reason: The register's own wording places this oak 'in the northern part of a garden plot' (Gartengrundstück), i.e. someone's private garden, distinct from the neighbouring ND-03742 oak which the same register describes only as standing 'southwest of' the school with no garden/courtyard language. Blocked per hard rule 10 (private land, not a dwelling anyone invited us to).
